description: Search the company project list (プロジェクト) used for man-hours (工数). Prefer get_my_projects when logging your own time; use this to search by name or code, or to see projects you might not belong to. activeOn is YYYY-MM-DD (Japan time) and keeps projects whose period includes that date. projectId goes to list_tasks and save_manhours.

activeOn.description: Only projects whose period includes this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

query.description: Case-insensitive text to match in name, short name, or code.

name: list_projects
title: List projects
